title: Finite-stage factorization for bounded-below integral constructible Hom
statement: Let ℓ be prime, E a finite normed extension of ℚ_ℓ and X a scheme with Noetherian underlying space. In the ordinary uncompleted derived category of internal modules over R=condensedRingObj(integralCoeff ℓ E) X from def-weil-pbc-continuous-integral-coefficients, let K be bounded constructible. Let D be a sequential diagram of cochain complexes of R-modules with a colimit cocone c, and assume there is one integer a with Q(D_n) in D≥a for every n. Every map K→Q(c.pt) equals g followed by Q(c.ι_n) for some n and some g:K→Q(D_n).

proof.text: Lift the natural-number sequence to AsSmall(ℕ) using its categorical equivalence. Whiskering transports the given colimit cocone and the common cohomological lower bound.

Apply lem-weil-pbc-integral-constructible-sheaf-hom to every constructible cohomology sheaf of K. The Hom-colimit property is closed under source isomorphisms and shifts and contains zero. Distinguished extension closure follows from the filtered long exact Hom sequence. Apply the proved source-library DerivedCategory.prop_of_bounded to this triangulated object property, using boundedness and constructibility of every cohomology object of K.

At shift zero the resulting Hom cocone is a colimit of additive groups. The concrete filtered-colimit representative theorem gives a stage and a morphism representing the specified map. Naturality of the shift-zero isomorphism removes the zero shift, and the indexing equivalence returns an ordinary natural-number stage with exactly the original cocone leg.

proof_origin.note: A4 Lean proof of bounded complex-source continuity from the sheaf-source geometric input, using the existing bounded devissage API and the concrete filtered-colimit representative theorem.

lean.statement: theorem integralConstructible_hom_sequential_colimit (X : Scheme.{u}) [TopologicalSpace.NoetherianSpace X] (K : integralConstructible ℓ E X) (D : ℕ ⥤ CochainComplex (Mod (Sheaf (Scheme.ProEt.topology X) Ab.{u + 1}) (condensedRingObj (integralCoeff ℓ E) X)) ℤ) (c : Cocone D) (hc : Nonempty (IsColimit c)) (hD : ∃ a : ℤ, ∀ n : ℕ, (DerivedCategory.Q.obj (D.obj n)).IsGE a) (f : K.obj ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj c.pt) : ∃ (n : ℕ) (g : K.obj ⟶ DerivedCategory.Q.obj (D.obj n)), g ≫ DerivedCategory.Q.map (c.ι.app n) = f
